headline: Traders Raise Netanyahu Exit Odds to 56% by Mid-2027
summary: Prediction markets and traders increased the probability of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu leaving office by mid-2027 to 56%, up 16.5 points in a week.
why: Shifts in political leadership expectations in the Middle East influence geopolitical risk premiums and regional investment sentiment.

impacts.name: Israel
impacts.why: Changes in government leadership forecasts alter domestic political and defense policy expectations.
